description: Gem Shop balance, purchase counters, and displayed gem quotes for the regular save.

extractions.label: gem_balance
extractions.description: Account gem balance. Public profiles can omit this private value.

extractions.label: catalog_quotes
extractions.expression: idleon.getAttr('CustomLists').h.MTXinfo.flatMap((group, g) => group.flatMap((rows, s) => rows.map((row, slot) => ({ group: g, section: s, slot, counterId: Number(row[4]), shopName: row[1], purchased: Number(idleon.getAttr('GemItemsPurchased')[Number(row[4])]), displayedCost: Math.round(Number(idleon.getAttr('GemItemsPurchased')[Number(row[4])]) * Number(row[7]) + Number(row[3])) })))).filter(row => [2, 5, 55, 56, 65, 103, 112, 128, 140].includes(row.counterId))
extractions.description: Read native catalog rows and saved counters. Apply the original display arithmetic from idleon1.24.txt:483288-483291, not a purchase action. Includes fixed and rising quotes, capped rows, zero counters, and both card packs sharing counter 65.
